meta_description:
chapter2drip on September 6, 2026: "Washed Past.
Not anymore.

The memories, the loops. 
Not stuck in them anymore.

Our Washed Past Collection is about moving on from your past, embracing change as the only constant, and choosing to be present in the now.

With silhouettes selectively washed to create defined forms, no two garments are exactly the same, because no two pasts are the same.

Be in the now.

LIVE NOW
Available Online & In stores
🔗 www.chapter2drip.com

#Chapter2Drip #WashedPast

Models: @sanskariaf @nniharrr @nirajislost @takshillalwani @dhruv.280".
